name: Zhao Gu
bio: Zhao Gu (趙嘏, c. 806–c. 853) was a late-Tang poet who passed the jinshi examination in 842 and held minor office. He is remembered above all for the line 長笛一聲人倚樓, "a long flute-note, and a man leans on the tower", from his autumn poem on Chang'an, which won him the nickname "Zhao Yilou".

poems.title: 聞笛 (Wen di)
poems.author: Zhao Gu
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
誰家吹笛畫樓中，斷續聲隨斷續風。
響遏行雲橫碧落，清和冷月到簾櫳。
興來三弄有桓子，賦就一篇懷馬融。
曲罷不知人在否，餘音嘹亮尚飄空。
